newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BOTHAM BACK ON BOARD WITH ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BOTHAM BACK ON BOARD WITH ENGLAND.

text.p: Former-all rounder and captain Ian Botham is back on board with the England cricket team.
Botham, who has been involved in media work since his retirement three years ago, has been asked to act as a technical adviser on the upcoming tour of Zimbabwe and New Zealand.

Botham, England's leading test wicket-taker, will be on the tour as a Sky TV commentator. But England team coach David Lloyd said on Thursday Botham would be involved in bowling coaching as England also try to prepare for next year's Ashes series against Australia.
Lloyd said: "Ian is very happy to be asked and the invitation has come from me. I have been mates with him for a long time and this is a personal arrangement."
The England team leave for their 14-week tour on November 25.
